title: Schedule I and II ordering by Form 222 or CSOS
rule_summary: A distribution of Schedule I or II controlled substances generally requires a DEA Form 222 or a compliant digitally signed electronic order unless a listed exception applies.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply ordering requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Schedule I and II ordering by Form 222 or CSOS

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing ordering with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
